subject.title: Feature: groupScope option to consolidate group sessions into main

question: Should selected multi-participant group or channel conversations be allowed to share the agent main session, and should that opt-in be per-binding only or also available as a global default?
rationale: This permanent configuration controls cross-participant context exposure; source correctness cannot determine the intended privacy policy.

options.title: Per-binding opt-in only
options.body: Allow only explicitly matched trusted conversations to join main, minimizing accidental context sharing.

options.title: Global plus per-binding
options.body: Support a global default with binding exceptions, improving convenience but widening misconfiguration blast radius.

options.title: Retain isolation
options.body: Keep group and channel peers isolated and reject main-session sharing as an unsupported trust model.

recommendation.title: Per-binding opt-in only
recommendation.body: Allow only explicitly matched trusted conversations to join main, minimizing accidental context sharing.

likelyOwner.reason: Direct issue involvement and sustained ownership of the central routing/session paths make this the strongest available decision owner.
